title: Balanced circle packings from terminal tangle decorations
status: Draft; literal even terminal decoration enforces strict complete balance and gives the stated long-filling volume corollary for the resulting fixed knots
imports: Complete packing and original primitive markings from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Proposition 2.1 and Section 2.

Actual shared source, full-Hermite filling norm and reduced-invariant normalization from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds; local sector envelopes from Spectral bounds and asymptotics of Casimir sources, Theorem 1.1.

The finite-certificate criterion from Shared face estimates and triangular gluing for planar link diagrams; the central expansion from Spectral bounds and asymptotics of Casimir sources, Theorem 8.1 and Section 14; the whole filling sum from Oscillatory filling sums with independently long twists; primitive completion and absolute volume from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links.
The decoration and original pairing are fixed before the level. All old and new powers must be independently sufficiently long; the knot type can change.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
